model_annotation: Figure 2 is a pie chart illustrating the distribution of opinions regarding the preparedness and qualifications of executors and designers for constructing passive houses in Bulgaria, based on survey responses. The chart is divided into four distinct segments, each representing a different level of perceived preparedness. The largest segment, colored green and accounting for 51% of the responses, corresponds to the view that “only a small part of the executors/designers are prepared to implement projects according to the Passive House standard, and a large number of specialists need training to comply with the standard.” The second-largest segment, colored purple and representing 23% of responses, indicates that “executors/designers are well-prepared and qualified to implement projects according to the Passive House standard.” A red segment, also at 23%, reflects the opinion that “only a small part of the executors/designers are prepared to implement projects according to the Passive House standard, and a large number of specialists need training to comply with the standard.” The smallest segment, colored blue and comprising 3% of responses, represents the view that “there are not enough prepared and qualified specialists for constructing passive houses according to the Passive House standard.” A legend to the right of the chart matches each color to its corresponding statement, and percentage values are displayed directly within each segment. No segment is visually exploded or emphasized beyond its proportional size.
